record.student_summary: You can do your summer internship as CPT once your I-20 is extended to December 15, 2027 for your fall thesis and your department confirms it counts for credit. Send your offer letter today and wait for your new I-20 before starting work on June 1. For winter break, you can visit Ghana if you get a travel signature before you leave and have a valid visa when you return — if it has expired, renew it before coming back.
